prompts.RiderPerspective: Create an ORIGINAL detailed hand-painted 2.5D game motorcycle sprite animation atlas on genuine transparent background. The reference is our Speed Rovers red motorcycle, black helmet, navy suit, red/white shoulder chevron: preserve that identity. EXACT FIVE COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS, equal grid, each full bike/rider fits with clear alpha gutters and both tires/boots complete. More convincing multi-angle volume than reference. Fixed slightly low chase-camera, not overhead. Columns represent steering camera-relative orientation: column1 rear three-quarter view yawed 18 degrees left with a strong left lean; column2 rear three-quarter view yawed 9 degrees left mild lean; column3 straight rear upright; column4 rear three-quarter yawed 9 degrees right mild lean; column5 rear three-quarter yawed 18 degrees right strong lean. SHOW the side fairing, front fork and front wheel edge in the turning views, not merely rotating a flat rear silhouette. Keep rear tire contact horizontally centered within each cell at 95 percent height. Rider counterbalances with shoulders, bent elbows, knees and planted feet on pegs, same physique and motorcycle across all 20 cells. Rows are four consecutive suspension and tire-spin frames, small consistent changes only: neutral, compress, release, recover. Lighting from upper left, volume from leather creases and mechanical highlights, dark edge on right. Sharp realistic painted game-art finish, not cartoon, not a photograph, not a 3D model render. No ground, shadows, typography, outlines, frame labels, lines, borders, extra limbs. Entire atlas roughly 2000x1800.
prompts.TrafficAnimated: Create a transparent animated sprite atlas for an original painted-sprite 2.5D highway racer. Reference provides four vehicles and exact art style. EXACT uniform grid FOUR columns x THREE rows. Columns are same four vehicles: yellow taxi sedan, burgundy sedan, white delivery van, teal bus. View directly from behind at low chase camera, full vehicle isolated, complete wheels and mirrors. Rows are THREE consecutive driving-animation frames: small suspension bounce with rear tire tread motion and subtly changing tail-lamp glow, same camera and size for each vehicle in each row. No dramatic pose/shape changes. Preserve vehicle identity. Equal cell dimensions, 8 percent clear alpha gutter each side, common tire baseline at 94 percent cell height. Genuine transparent background, no ground/shadows/grid/labels/text. Detailed textured hand-painted PC/3DO era sprite realism, glass reflections, chrome and rubber, original designs without logos. Atlas approximately 1800x1500.
prompts.FoliageAnimated: Create transparent sprite animation atlas for original 2.5D painted highway racer. Highly detailed hand-painted 1990s PC game sprite quality, textured natural leaves, readable silhouettes, warm sunlight above and cool shadows beneath, not pixel art or cartoon. No ground, cast shadows, borders, labels, text, overlapping cells. Genuine transparent background, original art. Atlas 1500x2000.
prompts.WaterAnimated: Production 2D texture animation atlas, square 1536x1536 divided into EXACT FOUR COLUMNS and TWO ROWS, eight equal square cells, no borders or gutters.
